tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read any page on this site as markdown, without the navigation and page furniture. Pass a URL returned by search_library.

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search this organisation's library of articles, videos and activities about children's social and emotional health. Returns titles, summaries and URLs. Plain-language questions work better than keywords.

query.description: What to search for, in plain language.

type.description: Which part of the site to search. Defaults to the resource library.
